note: The fetch ledger and the claim ledger of WP-79, the second set of gated founder briefs (first-100-customers, pre-seed-evidence-pack, first-hires; docs/wave8-contracts.md, section 9). Every page below was fetched with WebFetch in the writing session on 2026-10-11, and a quote was checked against the fetched page in a second fetch before it went into a brief. Each claim restates a sentence of a brief, with a locator and, for a regulation, a verbatim quote of 25 words or fewer from a government or standards host. Pages that returned 404, a binary document or an unreadable page were dropped and nothing is cited from them. A vendor page (docs.stripe.com) sources a paraphrase only.
